lines.text: Many learners say: I have many homework.
Better: I have a lot of homework.
We can't count homework. Say a lot of.
A lot of! I have a lot of homework today.

data.right: I have a lot of homework.

native.tip: Kita bilang “banyak PR” tanpa bentuk jamak. Di bahasa Inggris, homework tidak bisa dihitung, jadi pakai a lot of, bukan many.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I have many homework.” 😅 Homework tidak bisa dihitung, jadi pakai a lot of: “I have a lot of homework.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “a lot of”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I have a lot of homework.” lalu tulis satu kalimat tentang PR-mu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “banyak PR” with no plural form. In English, homework cannot be counted, so use a lot of, not many.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I have many homework.” 😅 Homework cannot be counted, so use a lot of: “I have a lot of homework.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
